correctness.rationale: PASS. For fixed finite N>=3, two strictly positive sink strengths give a contractive semigroup. Real-energy eigenspaces reduce the nonnormal generator and consist exactly of Hermitian H_phi eigenvectors vanishing at both sites; Jordan growth on the real axis is excluded by contractivity and all other modes decay. The plane-wave collision criterion has degeneracies only at total flux 0 or pi; the two-sink dark condition is L|(2k) or L|(2k+1), L=N/gcd(N,s). Counting non-self-paired k yields the piecewise dark dimensions and roots-of-unity cosine sums yield the five sitewise profiles and trace average. Independent exact phase-pair counting and sitewise finite sums for every N=3..16 and each separation agree. The conclusions concern t->infinity at fixed parameters; no uniform absorption-time claim follows.
residual_risks: No generic-flux lifetime bound, unequal hopping, phase disorder, many-particle dynamics or more than two absorbers.
Finite enumerations N<=16 do not prove all N.
